description: Create a new spreadsheet with one tab per entry, each tab's values loaded from a local .csv or .tsv file (delimiter from extension). Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the new spreadsheet's id, per-tab {name, sheet_id} pairs, and total cells written arrive via a follow-up message once creation completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a Google Sheets spreadsheet with one tab per local CSV or TSV file, as a background job. Dispatch parses and validates every file and unique tab name up front and returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the spreadsheet id, ordered tab names with Google sheet ids, and the total cells written.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for spreadsheet creation; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to create a multi-tab Google spreadsheet from local csv/tsv files.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title; tabs empty or not a list of {name, file_path} dicts; duplicate tab names; a file_path that is not absolute, does not exist, is empty, or has an extension other than .csv/.tsv; missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: the error message names the offending tab entry — fix the path/extension/name and re-dispatch; nothing was created, so a retry is clean. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
